what: Test MAE broken out by time control and by rating bracket, against the study's factor-of-two threshold.
sources: CCS Thesis - Integrated/chapters/chapter4.tex (subgroup performance by time control; by rating bracket)
threshold_note: The study set the threshold that no subgroup exceeds twice the overall MAE.
counting_note: A rating bracket counts each side of a game as its own sample under its own bracket, so the bracket counts sum to 510,000 while the time-control counts sum to 255,000 games.
subset_note: The 50k-subset column is the baseline-reproduction sanity gate and is a pipeline reference point only, not comparable with the full-corpus arms.
breaches: Only the 2401+ bracket breaches the threshold, and narrowly: 350.62 / 171.92 = 2.04 for the full model and 354.27 / 175.00 = 2.02 for the reproduced baseline.
